description: Send a message to a dataset seller to ask questions before purchasing — about freshness, schema details, geographic coverage, or update frequency. Messaging is free and does not require a prior purchase. Sellers typically respond within 24 hours.

dataset_id.description: The dataset being asked about — helps the seller answer in context

message.description: The question for the seller — be specific about what you need to know

seller_id.description: The seller user ID — found in the seller field of any dataset response

subject.description: Brief subject line, e.g. "Question about SF Rent 2024 dataset"

name: contact_seller
